description: This file implements the 'Stop' task class for a media player, responsible for stopping playback, changing pipeline state, and updating context flags.

classes.name: Stop
classes.description: A class representing the stop task for the media player, responsible for halting playback and cleaning up state.

methods.name: Stop::Stop
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Stop task with the given context and player interface.

methods.name: Stop::~Stop
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the Stop task.

methods.name: Stop::execute
methods.description: Executes the stop operation: stops position reporting, changes pipeline state to null, and updates context flags.
